rice.name: Rice
rice.fertilizer_tips: Apply nitrogen in split doses; use phosphorus at transplanting for strong root growth.
rice.description: A staple cereal crop that thrives in warm, humid conditions with standing water.

maize.name: Maize
maize.fertilizer_tips: Needs high nitrogen; apply in split doses during vegetative and tasseling stages.
maize.description: A versatile cereal grown widely for food, feed, and industrial use.

chickpea.name: Chickpea
chickpea.fertilizer_tips: Being a legume, it fixes its own nitrogen - focus on phosphorus and potassium instead.
chickpea.description: A cool-season legume valued for its protein-rich seeds, grown mostly in dry conditions.

kidneybeans.name: Kidney Beans
kidneybeans.fertilizer_tips: Low nitrogen need (legume); ensure adequate phosphorus and potassium.
kidneybeans.description: A cool-climate legume grown for its distinctive kidney-shaped seeds.

pigeonpeas.name: Pigeon Peas
pigeonpeas.fertilizer_tips: Nitrogen-fixing legume - starter dose of nitrogen plus adequate phosphorus is enough.
pigeonpeas.description: A hardy, drought-tolerant legume widely grown for its protein-rich split peas (dal).

mothbeans.name: Moth Beans
mothbeans.fertilizer_tips: Extremely drought-tolerant legume; minimal fertilizer needed beyond phosphorus.
mothbeans.description: A highly drought-resistant legume suited to arid and semi-arid regions.

mungbean.name: Mung Bean
mungbean.fertilizer_tips: Legume with low nitrogen needs; apply phosphorus and potassium at sowing.
mungbean.description: A fast-maturing legume popular for its small green seeds, used widely in South Asian cuisine.

blackgram.name: Black Gram
blackgram.fertilizer_tips: Legume - starter nitrogen dose plus phosphorus supports early growth.
blackgram.description: A short-duration legume grown for its dark, protein-rich lentils (urad dal).

lentil.name: Lentil
lentil.fertilizer_tips: Nitrogen-fixing legume; prioritize phosphorus for root and pod development.
lentil.description: A cool-season legume grown for its small lens-shaped, protein-rich seeds.

pomegranate.name: Pomegranate
pomegranate.fertilizer_tips: Balanced NPK feeding, with extra potassium during fruit development for better yield.
pomegranate.description: A drought-tolerant fruit shrub prized for its juicy, antioxidant-rich seeds (arils).

banana.name: Banana
banana.fertilizer_tips: Heavy feeder - needs high potassium and nitrogen throughout its growth cycle.
banana.description: A fast-growing tropical fruit crop that needs consistent warmth, humidity, and water.

mango.name: Mango
mango.fertilizer_tips: Balanced NPK in early growth; increase potassium during flowering and fruit set.
mango.description: A tropical fruit tree valued worldwide for its sweet fruit, needing a distinct dry flowering period.

grapes.name: Grapes
grapes.fertilizer_tips: Moderate nitrogen with higher potassium during fruit ripening for better sugar content.
grapes.description: A woody vine fruit crop that prefers dry, sunny conditions with controlled irrigation.

watermelon.name: Watermelon
watermelon.fertilizer_tips: High potassium during fruiting improves sweetness; avoid excess nitrogen late in the season.
watermelon.description: A warm-season vine crop grown for its large, sweet, water-rich fruit.

muskmelon.name: Muskmelon
muskmelon.fertilizer_tips: Balanced NPK early on; boost potassium as fruits develop for better flavor.
muskmelon.description: A warm-season melon crop similar to watermelon, needing dry weather during fruit maturation.

apple.name: Apple
apple.fertilizer_tips: Balanced NPK with emphasis on potassium for fruit quality; needs cold winters to set fruit.
apple.description: A temperate fruit tree that requires a distinct cold dormancy period to flower and fruit well.

orange.name: Orange
orange.fertilizer_tips: Balanced NPK with micronutrients (zinc, iron); avoid waterlogging around roots.
orange.description: A subtropical citrus tree that prefers warm days, cool nights, and moderate rainfall.

papaya.name: Papaya
papaya.fertilizer_tips: Frequent, moderate doses of balanced NPK support its fast, continuous growth.
papaya.description: A fast-growing tropical fruit tree that produces fruit year-round in warm climates.

coconut.name: Coconut
coconut.fertilizer_tips: Needs regular potassium and chlorine (common in coastal soils) for healthy nut development.
coconut.description: A tropical palm best suited to humid coastal regions with consistent warmth and rainfall.

cotton.name: Cotton
cotton.fertilizer_tips: High nitrogen demand during vegetative growth; potassium is key for fiber quality.
cotton.description: A major fiber crop that needs a long, warm frost-free growing period.

jute.name: Jute
jute.fertilizer_tips: Moderate nitrogen supports fiber growth; avoid excess to prevent lodging.
jute.description: A fiber crop that thrives in hot, humid conditions with plentiful monsoon rainfall.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.fertilizer_tips: Balanced NPK with organic matter; shade-grown coffee also benefits from nitrogen-fixing cover crops.
coffee.description: A shade-loving shrub grown at higher elevations, valued worldwide for its beans.
